text: A reading corner can be as simple as a comfortable chair and a little daylight. What small detail makes a space feel inviting enough to settle down with a book?
A free afternoon, a board game and something small to eat: a lovely combination. Which game would you choose for a group where some people are playing for the first time?

Learning a craft often begins with one small project. A simple stitched bookmark, for example, leaves room to practise without needing much material. What would you suggest as a first project for someone curious about textiles?
Here is a little photography prompt: choose one colour, then notice how it changes in different light. You could try it with three objects at home. Which colour would you start with?
Small repair projects are easier to pause when every screw has somewhere to go. A labelled container can save plenty of searching later. What simple trick helps you keep a hobby project organised?
